ecg.title: ECG device
ecg.subtitle: Connect your portable ECG over Bluetooth and watch the live waveform.
ecg.connectionHelp: Turn the device on and tap Connect. Keep it close to the computer.
ecg.connectionHelpWindows: On Windows, Chrome often cannot open a GATT link to AIECG. Use the desktop agent below — it is the reliable path.
ecg.scrollHint: Drag the chart or the slider to browse the full recording
ecg.photoHelp: A picture of paper ECG, a monitor screen, or a single-lead strip.
ecg.photoNotEcg: No ECG is visible in this photo

photoErr.AI_NOT_CONFIGURED: AI is not configured on the server (Anthropic or OpenAI key).
photoErr.INVALID_INPUT: Could not read the image. Use JPG or PNG.
photoErr.LLM_UPSTREAM_ERROR: Analysis is temporarily unavailable. Try again.

ecg.needChrome: Open this page in Chrome or Edge on a computer with Bluetooth.
ecg.insecureContext: Bluetooth is not available on this link. Open the app in Chrome or Edge on this computer.
ecg.tipPower: Turn the device on and keep it nearby until Connected appears.
ecg.tipWindows: Do not pair the device in your computer’s Bluetooth settings — connect only from this page.
ecg.tipChrome: Close WeChat / the Python agent first; only one app can hold the BLE link.

err.not_found: Device not found. Turn it on nearby and do not pair it in your computer’s Bluetooth settings.
err.security: Open the app in the browser on this computer.
err.gatt: Could not connect. Close other apps that may be using the device, then try again.
err.busy: Bluetooth is busy. Wait a second and try again.
err.unsupported: Open this page in Chrome or Edge on a computer with Bluetooth.

ecg.linkHelp: If browser Bluetooth fails, create a code and run the Python agent on this PC.
ecg.linkHelpWindows: Create a pair code, then run the command in a terminal. Keep this page open to see the live waveform.
ecg.agentAfter: After the agent prints “connected”, refresh devices on this page — the list fills only after a successful claim/bind.
ecg.noDevices: No devices yet. Connect the device with the button above.
ecg.waitingSignal: Waiting for a signal. Connect the device and touch the electrodes.
ecg.waitingExplain: Connected. Keep holding the electrodes — the waveform should appear in a few seconds.
ecg.noNotifiesYet: Connected, but no signal yet. Keep holding the electrodes or reconnect.
ecg.lastNotify: BLE notifies: {{n}} · last len={{len}} samples={{samples}} hex={{hex}}
ecg.liveHint: Waveform appears when multi-sample BLE frames arrive (handshake ACKs are ignored).
ecg.screenHelp: Hold electrodes for at least 20 seconds, then screen. Single-lead only — not a clinic ECG.
ecg.screenNeedStrip: Need a longer, cleaner strip (about 8 seconds or more).
ecg.screenDisclaimer: This is not a medical diagnosis and does not replace a clinician.
